deployments_detail.use: Superton AI voice-synthesis acquisition (56.1% stake, KRW 4.5B); AI voice tech across platforms; Weverse fan platform

AI voice-synthesis used to release MIDNATT's debut single 'Masquerade' simultaneously in six languages, applying native-speaker pronunciation data to the singer's own voice for accurate multilingual delivery [Supertone (HYBE subsidiary)]
SYNDI8, a four-member virtual pop group whose vocals are entirely generated by AI voice-cloning technology, debuted with the single 'MVP' [Supertone (HYBE subsidiary)]

Supertone Shift, a real-time AI voice changer that analyzes 10 seconds of a user's speech and converts it into predefined voices/characters for streaming, gaming, and dubbing (launched to open beta) [Supertone (HYBE subsidiary)]
Supertone AI voice production used to create a character's voice for Netflix's series 'Song of the Bandits', an AI-based voice project for on-screen content [Supertone (HYBE subsidiary)]
AI-generated vocals for virtual pop group Syndi8 [Supertone]
AI for pronunciation assistance and accessibility across six languages for artist MIDNATT

Supertone text-to-speech tool and voice API (Sona Speech / Supertonic models) that generates expressive custom voices from a ~10-second sample across languages including English, Korean and Japanese, offered to creators and businesses [Supertone (HYBE subsidiary)]

Weverse superfan platform deployed Google Cloud conversational AI (ML + NLP) to provide 24/7 automated fan support for inquiries on ticket reservations, merchandise purchases, and platform features across global traffic spikes [Google Cloud (conversational AI / Vertex AI)]
Weverse AI-powered automatic machine translation of artists' posts, comments, live-stream chat and auto-generated subtitles into up to 15-16 languages to enable cross-language fan-artist interaction
AI for audio cleaning and fan engagement on Weverse platform

'Face Pass' facial-recognition entry system rolled out at HYBE artist concerts and fan events, allowing fans to enter venues via a face scan instead of ID/ticket checks (also aimed at combating scalping); developed with fintech Toss [Toss (co-developed)]
Real-time monitoring and enforcement system to detect and take down AI deepfake videos exploiting HYBE artists, run alongside a dedicated infringement reporting portal

AI-driven monitoring to detect intellectual-property infringement and counterfeit merchandise across global platforms, removing counterfeit listings (incl. ~92,208 from Amazon over four months) as part of HYBE's IP-protection program
deployments_detail.value: ~400,000 illegal listings detected; 92,208 counterfeit listings removed from Amazon in 4 months; 20,000+ counterfeit items seized
